about.meta_desc: Who we are, what we cover and why we do it from Andorra.
about.lead: Valira Valley started from a simple observation: interesting things happen in Andorra and around it when it comes to business, investment and innovation, and almost nobody covers them rigorously. This is where they get covered.
about.mission_p1: We interview founders, executives and investors to understand how they decide: what they bet on, what went wrong, what they would change. No marketing script and no softball questions.
about.mission_p2: Artificial intelligence runs through every episode, but not as a trend: as a concrete tool already reshaping margins, processes and teams. We care about what can be applied, not what can be posted.
about.mission_p3: We publish in four languages because Andorra's ecosystem is, by definition, cross-border.
about.naming_sub: Valira Valley brings together two references: the territory it comes from and the world's benchmark for innovation.
about.valira_def: The river running through the Principality of Andorra. Origin, identity and local roots.
about.valley_def: Silicon Valley, the global reference for technology, innovation and entrepreneurship.
about.naming_result: Origin and ambition: business content with a local accent and an international standard.
about.f1_desc: An hour with a founder or executive, structured around concrete decisions and their consequences.
about.f2_desc: A breakdown of a real business model: unit economics, channel, competition and where technology fits.
about.f3_desc: Conditions and sectors across the Andorran and global economy, with data and without alarmist headlines.
about.f4_desc: Taxation, legal framework and the particularities of the Principality, explained by specialists.
about.f5_desc: Finance, management and AI concepts explained without jargon and with workable examples.
about.andorra_p1: Andorra packs a dense business ecosystem into very little territory: private banking, retail, tourism and a growing wave of digital companies that have set up here in recent years. That density makes decisions visible and consequences traceable.
about.andorra_p2: It is a good laboratory for talking about business: small enough to see whole, connected enough to Spain, France and the rest of Europe for the conclusions to travel.
about.cta_sub: If you want to appear on an episode, suggest a guest or work with us, get in touch.

services.meta_desc: AI consulting, team training and corporate podcast production.
services.lead: The podcast forces us to stay current on what works in real companies. We apply the same standard when we work with teams: concrete use cases, short timelines and results you can measure.
services.s1_desc: We identify where AI adds real value to your operation, prioritise by impact and effort, and support the rollout.
services.s1_for: For managing directors and heads of operations ready to move from interest to execution.
services.s2_desc: Practical workshops for non-technical roles. People leave knowing which tools to use, how to fit them into their work and where the limits are.
services.s2_b1: Half-day or full-day sessions, on site or online
services.s2_b2: Exercises built on real cases from your company
services.s2_b3: Materials and usage guides for after the workshop
services.s2_b4: Tailored by function: leadership, sales, marketing, operations
services.s2_for: For teams already using AI in scattered ways who need a shared standard.
services.s3_desc: We design and produce the podcast format for companies that want to build brand authority with their own content.
services.s3_b1: Format, editorial line and audience definition
services.s3_b4: Training your in-house team to take it over in time
services.s3_for: For B2B companies with knowledge worth sharing and no channel to share it on.
services.p1_desc: 45 minutes to understand your context and decide whether we can help. No cost, no commitment.
services.p2_desc: Scope, timeline and price in writing. No open-ended retainers.
services.p3_desc: Milestone-based work with regular reviews. You always know where things stand.
services.p4_desc: We leave you with documentation and a team trained to carry on without us.
services.cta_sub: Send us two lines about your situation and we will tell you whether we can help, and how.
